title: A-race: Example Ironman
body: First full-distance race. Priorities: durability on long rides, pacing, fueling.

title: Previous half-distance time
body: Half-distance finish in 5:30 last season. About 2 years of triathlon experience.

title: Achilles: tendinopathy (physio ongoing)
body: Right Achilles flares up after sudden jumps in running volume. Physio-led calf loading twice a week. Build running gradually.

title: Weekly structure
body: Two strength sessions per week (Tuesday and Saturday). The coached swim is on Thursday.

title: Check TSH again
body: TSH was near the top of the range in the last panel; the doctor asked for a re-test.

title: Devices
body: Garmin watch and bike computer, chest strap, single-sided power pedals.
